requirements.requirement: I authorize Paper 15 manuscript preparation, supplementary materials, figures, PDFs, scientific claim auditing, and reproducibility documentation.
This is a RESULTS-LOCKED WRITING AND REPORTING MISSION.
No new neural data collection, model fitting, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, hypothesis testing or Final D assessment is authorized.
The scientific results of M0–M6 are fixed.
Preserve all original source evidence and negative or inconclusive scientific outcomes.
And all relevant archived animal-level, numerical, sensitivity, control and independent-review tables.
Verify immutable source identities and historical protocol boundaries.
Never replace archived scientific results with values reconstructed from assumptions.
Use saved calculations and verified result tables as the authoritative scientific record.
Cross-check manuscript numbers against archived primary evidence.
Do not execute any neural prediction worker.
Do not read or reassess Final D neural arrays.
"Predictive Contributions of Local Spike History in Mouse Primary Motor Cortex: A Development and Independent-Animal Descriptive Evaluation"
Methods-oriented empirical secondary analysis with exploratory Development and descriptive independent-animal evaluation.
Does strictly past local mouse MOp spike history contribute predictive information beyond a strong task, stimulus, wheel-movement and firing-rate nuisance baseline?
Do compact discrete-state and continuous-history representations improve prediction beyond the strong combined history model?

A reproducible, causally indexed comparison of local neural-history prediction, conventional nuisance/history baselines, and compact dynamical representations using public mouse motor-cortex electrophysiology.
Do not frame the study as a discovery of physical cognitive primitives.
Six admitted animals from four laboratories.
- UCLA033: six C-qualified units, below the frozen eight-unit requirement.
All six Final primary mouse effects are positive.
This label is mandatory throughout the paper.
Do not describe the Final primary as confirmed, validated, robustly established or causally identified.
The eight-mouse confirmation floor is unmet.
The Final CI width is approximately 0.0916613, exceeding the frozen 0.01 precision requirement.
The statistical result remains conditional on the original mouse-effect symmetry and independence assumptions.
Report all five registered secondary contrasts.
Units: nats per actual scored nominal curated-release unit-bin.
Report exact archived confidence intervals, raw p-values and Holm-adjusted p-values in the original registered comparison order.
All five secondary Holm-adjusted tests are nonsignificant.
At n=6, the registered exhaustive two-sided sign-flip resolution makes the smallest possible five-test Holm-adjusted p-value 0.15625.
Do not reinterpret nonsignificance as equivalence.
Do not claim D or C superiority.
Do not claim persistent discrete biological states.
The Development D-B4 mean was negative while the Final descriptive mean was positive; report this difference without inventing a new pooled test or biological transition.
Report the eleven registered sensitivity cases, including failures and unavailable panels.
Never attribute B0-B4 sensitivity-refit results to D/C/S.
Report all four registered finite-reference suites and their actual available populations.
Unavailable at the aggregate level for both Development and Final, with only three qualifying Final mice.
Do not describe these surrogate procedures as assumption-free exact causal or mechanistic null tests.
N3 measures wheel-related B4 likelihood reliance, not all-movement independence or an independent D/C wheel null.
Preserve failed D-B4 and D-S descriptive disruption conditions.
Explain that positive N1/N2 observations in Final do not override the prospectively restricted DESCRIPTIVE ONLY verdict.
Produce a complete English-language scientific manuscript with:
Author and affiliation placeholders, without inventing personal names, institutional appointments or ORCIDs.
- Temporal predictive structure in neural populations
- The distinction between task/movement information and local neural history
- Why simple history-aware GLMs are demanding comparison baselines
- Why compact latent-state models require strong falsification
- Public IBL Brain Wide Map source
- Original MOp anatomy and unit selection
- Strictly past wheel and neural predictors
- Final C calibration and single D assessment
- What the observed predictive increments support
- Source annotation, movement and anatomy confounds
- Future work requiring new independent cohorts
Use scientifically restrained prose, not promotional slogans.
Produce a complete supplementary document containing:
- Exact data versions and access methods
- Final selected unit IDs and QC summaries
- Native timing and binary64 correction provenance
- Full model equations and parameter counts
- Hyperparameter grids, seeds and numerical policies
The earlier timestamp-serialization failure and separately authorized corrective execution should be documented as a transparent methodological correction.
Do not bury scientific failures in the supplement.
Generate figures from frozen saved result tables only.
Study design, original 20-mouse allocation and actual Development/Final attrition.
Primary B4-B1 animal-level Development and Final effects, separately displayed.
All six model contrasts, with correct signs, units and uncertainty.
N1/N2/N3/N4 falsification outcomes and unavailable coverage.
Sensitivity analyses across unit-count, history, binning, saturation and drift conditions.
Figures may be consolidated when doing so improves clarity.
Use actual values, not schematic effect-size illustrations masquerading as measured data.
Every error bar must identify the interval type and independent statistical unit.
Represent unavailable tests visibly, rather than hiding them.
Do not use asterisks or color to suggest confirmation when the full registered criterion failed.
Export high-resolution PNG/SVG/PDF figure files where supported.
Before finalizing the manuscript, conduct a claim-by-claim author-style scientific review.
A. Is the primary descriptive result accurately described?
B. Does the title avoid confirmation/causal implications?
C. Are the 10 Development and 6 Final animals distinguished everywhere?
D. Are the eight originally reserved Final mice and two attrition reasons disclosed?
E. Is the five-test Holm resolution limitation explained?
F. Are N1/N2 successes and N4 unavailability handled without selective interpretation?
G. Are the negative or inconclusive D/C findings represented fairly?
H. Are movement, anatomy, artifacts, sorting and laboratory dependencies disclosed?
I. Are the originally frozen thresholds preserved?
J. Are source licensing and bibliographic attribution verifiable?
Any claim without direct archived evidence must be removed or weakened.
Do not fabricate external peer review.
If an issue requires new neural experiments, mark it as a limitation or future work; do not rerun Final D.
Verify and cite the relevant original IBL Brain Wide Map work and official public-release documentation.
Identify the actual dataset version, source provider and CC BY 4.0 conditions.
Cite original methodological references for point-process GLMs, spike-history prediction, latent-state models and permutation/sign-flip testing where verified and relevant.
No fabricated papers, DOIs, author details or citation metadata.
Use primary sources when reasonably available.
Distinguish earlier work from the present secondary analysis.
Do not assert publication acceptance, peer review or bioRxiv acceptance.
A1 — Research question and frozen protocol
A2 — Data provenance, licensing and cohort
A4 — Exact mathematical models and strong baselines
A5 — Development/Final separation and leakage prevention
A9 — Negative findings, limits and prohibited claims
Every section must reference actual saved artifacts and manuscript figures/tables.
Do not manufacture completion of any missing original scientific gate.
Provide one-command saved-only scientific reproduction where feasible.
- Recompute published tables from saved mouse-level outcomes
- Retrieve neural outcomes for a second scientific evaluation
Distinguish saved-result reproduction from an independent reproduction of all raw-data fits.
Provide documentation for the original data-processing procedure without bypassing the consumed one-shot evaluation boundary.
Use a clean academic manuscript layout.
- No missing glyphs or clipped text
- Clearly differentiated Development and Final populations
- No accidental inclusion of private local machine paths in the manuscript
Inspect rendered PDFs for visual and content problems.
Repair ordinary formatting and document-production defects autonomously.
No scientific-result modification is authorized as a formatting repair.
Create a new versioned manuscript directory:
Do not overwrite prior scientific result packages.
Preserve original Development and Final result hashes.
Obtain independent internal document/scientific consistency review.
Commit and push the manuscript-only package to origin/test.
Verify remote commit SHA, changed-file contents and clean working tree.
Do not merge into main unless separately authorized.
A successful deliverable is a complete, truthful, technically polished scientific manuscript, including mixed and negative results.
It is not a claim that the original confirmatory research criteria were met.
Exact mission-only staging and normal origin/test push
Remote current SHA and every changed-file blob readback
Clean working tree before and after terminal receipt
Independent internal scientific/document review and all P0/P1 resolved
Final PDF pages visually inspected and no clipping/missing glyphs
STOP after manuscript handoff; no submission or next mission
